plainTranslation: Someone's personal planet in your 12th house - the hidden, under-the-surface part of your chart: a connection that feels old and runs below awareness. Often surfaces in dreams. Bring it into the light.
policy: Governed by synastry-policy. Descriptive, not deterministic; intensity is never treated as obligation, safety concerns override astrology.
